gate.significance: paired MAE delta 95% interval from a block bootstrap over (service day x KST hour) blocks of DEV_S must lie entirely below 0
gate.guardRule: a guard may not worsen beyond its service-day bootstrap 95% interval
gate.significanceNote: implementer refinement 2026-10-22: DEV_S has only 4 service days, so a day-only bootstrap is degenerate; hour blocks keep same-hour arrivals together

forbidden: H rows in any loop run (H opens once at loop end)
raw route or vehicle identifiers in public outputs

features.rule: hard features allowed only if production can compute them after a service change; each new feature declares its serving requirement

budget.overrun: stop the loop and report; never exceed without a new user decision

reporting.perRound: short Korean summary to the user

userConsultation: policy changes only; experiment-level choices belong to the planner

budgetAmendments.change: stop.noImprovementRounds 4 -> 8 (safety ceiling; judge may stop earlier)

planner.basis: official guidance: start with Opus 5.5; 2.5x cheaper than Fable 5.1 per token; grounding test 16/18 vs 0; to be re-validated on our own ledger

aiBudget.billing: Anthropic API key from the protected research key file; separate from the GPU budget
aiBudget.note: user chose API; amounts are the assistant proposal pending user adjustment

power.risk: lid-close sleep stops the local watchdog while a paid pod runs

debate.basis: debate research: gains flat after 2 round trips; early stop on agreement; deadlock -> conservative default

judge.floor: gatePassed is a hard veto; judge chooses among floor-passers or none
